items.label: Nonfarm Payrolls
items.headline: Nonfarm Payrolls reached 10M in September 2026, a gain of 5.3K jobs versus August 2026.

items.label: Unemployment Rate
items.headline: Unemployment Rate moved to 4.4% in September 2026, down 0.1 points versus August 2026.

items.label: Labor Force
items.headline: Labor Force reached 11.1M in September 2026, a loss of 755 versus August 2026.

items.label: Employment Level
items.headline: Employment Level reached 10.6M in September 2026, a gain of 12.7K versus August 2026.

items.label: Information Employment
items.headline: Information Employment reached 147.6K in September 2026, a loss of 1.2K jobs versus August 2026.

items.label: Professional & Business Services Employment
items.headline: Professional & Business Services Employment reached 1.6M in September 2026, a loss of 2.7K jobs versus August 2026.

items.label: Business Applications
items.headline: Business Applications reached 58.7K in September 2026, a loss of 2.3K versus August 2026.

items.label: Real GSP (chained dollars)
items.headline: Real GSP (chained dollars) for January 2025 was revised to $1.38T from $1.39T.
